summary: Initializes an interleaved 3-slot array of DWORD fields (12 DWORDs total) with an unconditional do/while loop of 3 iterations. Each iteration writes 0 to two fields (at DWORD base this+0x18 and this+0x24) and -1 to two earlier fields (DWORD v2-6 and v2-3), then returns the receiver pointer.

local_names.v2: running DWORD pointer starting at this+6, incremented each iteration
local_names.v3: iteration counter starting at 3, decremented to 0

operations.description: Unconditional do/while loop runs exactly 3 iterations (counter 3 decremented to 0, zero-exit)
Per iteration writes 0 to two DWORD fields: at DWORD pointer v2 (base offset this+0x18) and at v2+3 (base offset this+0x24)
Per iteration writes sentinel -1 to two earlier DWORD fields at v2-6 and v2-3
Returns the original this pointer unchanged
